evidence: Commit 40ec4455073d1a33fb6990b914d1cbc6c3c3eed9 requests BBM, one access slot per satellite, control-plane propagation, Gilbert-Elliott evaluation, non-oracle hop routing, no learning, and explicitly disclaims MBB effectiveness, outage occurrence, calibrated operator realism, speed, and DDQN.

Source tracing shows trace-active aggregate grid cells instantiate TrafficEndpoint objects rather than Gateway objects; association candidates use current simulation geometry; and hop routing obtains remote legal egress targets only from arrived, non-expired control-cache serve_cells.

Control packets share finite directional ISL queue capacity and service rate with data, receive non-preemptive priority, incur serialization and propagation delay, and are subject to TTL, geometry-loss, and Gilbert-Elliott transmission races.

A fresh local execution of the exact resolved config reached the 120 second horizon and delivered all 109 offered data packets over paths 0-1-2 or 2-1-0; data and control bit conservation verified. It admitted 14496 control instances to ISL queues, delivered 5760, expired 8064 by TTL, and left 672 in system at stop.

The same execution recorded only two pre-position associations at time zero on different satellites, with zero access requests, zero ordinary grants, zero releases, zero wait time, zero BBM events, and zero MBB events.
blocking_findings: The receipt semantics report mechanisms.effective.mbb=true whenever association is not mbb, so this BBM smoke reports MBB effective despite requesting no MBB and observing zero MBB events. That is incompatible with the package's explicit no-MBB-effectiveness claim.

The exact smoke does not exercise finite K=1 contention or a BBM switch: its two endpoints occupy different satellites through pre-position grants and never request, wait, release, or hand over. It therefore cannot serve as the declared integration gate for finite K=1 access and BBM semantics.

Formal V2 governance gates only requested control queue entry, any Gilbert-Elliott query, and requested MBB events. It does not require evidence of K=1 contention, current-geometry association legality, BBM switching, non-oracle cache use by a data decision, or data ISL forwarding, so research_eligible=true can be issued without exercising several mechanisms named by this smoke's acceptance objective.
